title: Share the Qwen3 Technical Report PDF from Files via Mail to david@research.com
instruction: In the Files app, locate the 'Qwen3 Technical Report' PDF and share it via Mail to david@research.com. Set the subject to 'Qwen3 Report' and the body to 'Please review the attached paper.'

steps.thought: First, my immediate thought is to locate the document. I know it's a PDF and that its title is 'Qwen3 Technical Report'. To do this, I'll need to access the Files application on my device. That's the starting point.
Let's long-press `qwen3.pdf` to select it and reveal the share option.

The file `qwen3.pdf` is now selected.
I see a share icon at the top right, next to the trash can.
I will click the share icon.

The share menu has popped up.
I need to share it via Mail.
I see the Mail app icon in the share menu.
I will click the Mail app icon.

The Mail app is opening, but it's currently a blank white screen.
I should wait a moment for it to load.

The Mail app has loaded the compose screen.
The file `qwen3.pdf` is attached at the bottom.
I need to fill in the 'To', 'Subject', and 'Compose email' fields.
First, I will click on the 'To' field to enter the recipient's email address: david@research.com.

The 'To' field is now active.
I will type the email address: david@research.com.
The email address is entered. I should press Enter to confirm it.

The recipient is set.
Now I need to set the subject to 'Qwen3 Report'.
I will click on the 'Subject' field.

The 'Subject' field is active.
I will type 'Qwen3 Report'.

The subject is set.
Now I need to set the body to 'Please review the attached paper.'.
I will click on the 'Compose email' field.

The 'Compose email' field is active.
I will type 'Please review the attached paper.'.

The email is fully composed.
Recipient: david@research.com
Subject: Qwen3 Report
Body: Please review the attached paper.
Attachment: qwen3.pdf
Now I need to send the email.
The send button is the paper airplane icon at the top right.
I will click the send button.

The email has been sent, and I am back in the Mail inbox.
The task is complete.
I will terminate the task with success.
